rationale: The assistant went straight to the correct, sensible first step (wash the pre-motor and post-motor filters, dry fully 24h, do not refit damp) and talked the customer out of buying a new vacuum, matching the hidden truth exactly; the fix was confirmed in two turns with no part recommended. Minor weaknesses: unplugging was only mentioned in the card rather than the text, the phrasing 'a clogged filter that needs time to dry out properly' is slightly muddled, and it did not ask about hose/wand blockages or filter history before directing, though the directive was proportionate and correct. The follow-up maintenance advice ('every few months') is reasonable and addresses the customer's stated unknown.
